problem: PB could record individual Experiences but had no mechanism to detect when the SAME structural situation (goal + experience_kind) repeated across multiple real cycles.

decision.decision_summary: Implemented detectPatterns() -- pure exact-key grouping, threshold >= 2 -- and connected confirmed patterns to Improvement Candidates.

action.action_summary: Implemented Pattern Detection + Registry; found 2 confirmed patterns (GPU repeat-failure x4, already addressed; ghibli repeat-success x4, new candidate generated) among 12 real experiences.

result.note: Adds a new Experience Layer capability; does not change this Goal's own real status.

cause.root_cause_summary: Pattern-level learning did not previously exist -- only individual-Experience retrieval (E3) and guidance (E4) did.

lesson: Requiring count>=2 with an EXACT structural key (not similarity) keeps Pattern Detection honest -- it found exactly the 2 patterns a manual review would also find (GPU repeats, ghibli successes), and correctly declined to call the single misjudgment_correction instance a "pattern" yet.
